explanation:
[EFFECT] Weather acts in steps: clear skies (1) give a small positive boost (~+0.03 to +0.05); mist or cloud (2) is near neutral to slightly negative; light rain or snow (3) strongly suppresses demand, with the bulk of hours falling between −0.15 and −0.65; the very few heavy-rain hours (4) also appear negative (around −0.2).
[IMPORTANCE] A moderate feature with a range of about 0.7 log-units; ranked around sixth or seventh, meaningful mainly because light-rain hours are fairly common.
